title: How to Charge Crystals: Moonlight, Sunlight, Sound and Intention
meta_title: How to Charge Crystals: Moonlight, Sun, Sound, Intention
meta_description: Charge crystals with moonlight, sunlight, sound, earth, or intention. Sunlight fades amethyst and rose quartz. This guide covers each method and which stones it suits.
open_evidence_gaps: No controlled studies confirm that charging practices alter any measurable stone property. All charging descriptions reflect tradition. Specific sun-fading timescales for amethyst and rose quartz vary by specimen and UV intensity; no single published threshold is cited.

title: How to Cleanse Crystals: Methods and Which Stones They Suit
meta_title: How to Cleanse Crystals: Every Method Explained
meta_description: Moonlight, sound, smoke, and water each suit different stones. Choose the right crystal cleansing method to avoid damaging selenite, lepidolite, or sun-sensitive stones.
open_evidence_gaps: No peer-reviewed study measures energy accumulation in crystals; the concept of energetic cleansing is tradition, stated as such throughout.

title: What Crystals Can Go in Water? A Safety Guide
meta_title: What Crystals Can Go in Water? Safety Guide
meta_description: Quartz-family stones (Mohs 7+) are generally safe for brief water contact. Selenite dissolves, malachite releases copper ions, and pyrite oxidizes in water.
open_evidence_gaps: Exact dissolution rates for selenite and calcite in standing versus running water not confirmed from a single primary source; stated conservatively.
